# Local Acceptance Workflow

This optional workflow is test guidance, not host authority. Do not use it unless selected by the user. Never enable or trust a package yourself.

Discover the current `trellis.acceptance` capability IDs and read their contracts. Invoke only the exact operation requested by the user. For echo, preserve the exact text. For propose, report "scheduled, not committed"; the independent Action and any human approval are authoritative. Do not repeat a request when its result is unknown. A tool invocation approval never approves a subsequent data/View mutation. Preserve and reset remain subject to host input checks and separate human reset confirmation.
